articles.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
articles.summary: Google Research released Harness2, an Apache-2.0 framework that rewrites an agent's harness at test time. One refinement step lifted GLM-5 by 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench with no weight updates. articles.title: nightly
articles.summary: Verifying the artifacts First, download the checksums.txt file and the checksums.txt.sigstore.json file files, for example, with wget : wget ' https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/nightly/checksums.txt ' wget ' https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/nightly/checksums.txt.sigstore.json ' Then, verify it using cosign : cosign verify-blob \ --certificate-identity-regexp ' ^https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/\.github/workflows/(release|nightly)\.yml@ ' \ --certificate-oidc-issuer ' https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ' \ --bundle '...

articles.title: How to Make Zero-Training Tabular Predictions with NVIDIA Structured Data Models
articles.summary: In this tutorial, we implement Structured Data Models, NVIDIA’s new library that puts several pretrained foundation models for tables behind one PyTorch interface, and use it to make predictions without training. articles.title: Meet Voxel51 3.0: A Unified Multimodal Data Platform for Physical AI
articles.summary: Voxel51 3.0 merges search, curation, annotation and evaluation of multimodal sensor data into one platform for physical AI teams. It adds Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools, dataset versioning, and a free self-service tier.
